topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the final lecture of the course and state its learning outcomes regarding cancer treatment approaches.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Therapies and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional treatment modalities including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy alongside their associated systemic toxicities and drug resistance mechanisms.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities and Checkpoint Defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe therapeutic strategies designed to exploit inherent cancer cell vulnerabilities such as hormone signaling dependence, defective cell cycle checkpoints, and impaired DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Targeting Oncogenic Kinases and Mechanisms of Inhibitor Resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on targeting oncogenic driver kinases with small-molecule inhibitors and understanding the molecular mechanisms behind drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Antibody Therapies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine antibody-based therapeutics, focusing on how monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates target cancer cell surface antigens.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and T-Cell-Mediated Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the role of the immune system in cancer and methods to harness T-cell cytotoxicity using checkpoint inhibitors, bispecific engagers, and CAR T cells.

topics.label: Therapeutic Challenges, Long-Term Progress, and Future Directions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the overall clinical progress, persisting challenges, ethical considerations, and future avenues in cancer therapy.
